title: Root
description: Base styles applied to the .root class: font family, size, line-height, color, and background

sections.title: Usage
sections.description: Add the .ui-root class to the html or body element to establish baseline typography and color.

examples.title: Basic setup

children.text: Text inherits font-family, size, line-height, and color from .ui-root

examples.code:
<html class="ui-root">
  <body>
    <!-- All children inherit base styles -->
  </body>
</html>

examples.title: Tokens applied
